blocks.text: Langley Holiday Events 2026: Lights, Markets and Parades

parts.t: Posted on
November 13, 2026
by
Jared Gibbons
Langley goes all out for the holidays, from Fort Langley's tree lighting to light shows and markets across the Township. Here's what's on in November and December 2026.

blocks.text: Making Merry at Willowbrook – Tuesday, November 17

parts.t: Willowbrook Shopping Centre's charity shopping night runs from 7 to 10 p.m., with live music and visits with Santa.

blocks.text: Glow Christmas Treasures – November 19 to January 2

parts.t: Glow Langley's indoor light show runs through the season. Tickets and times are on the
Glow Langley site

blocks.text: Merry & Bright at Martini Town – November 20 to December 31

parts.t: A holiday film set turned light walk, open on select dates from 3 to 10 p.m. Tickets are required in advance (
Merry & Bright

blocks.text: Langley Grand Christmas Market – Saturday, November 21

parts.t: Held at South Langley Church.

blocks.text: Aldergrove Christmas Tree Lighting – Sunday, November 22

parts.t: From 4 to 7 p.m. at 270 Street and Fraser Highway (
Christmas in Aldergrove

blocks.text: Langley Christmas Village – November 26 to December 24

parts.t: Free admission, along Fraser Highway in downtown Langley City (
Langley Christmas Village

blocks.text: Fort Langley Tree Lighting – Saturday, November 28

parts.t: On the front grounds of the Fort Langley Community Hall. Festivities start at 2 p.m., the Langley Community Music School children's choir sings at 4:45 p.m., and the tree is lit at 5:30 p.m.

blocks.text: Aldergrove Light Up Parade – Saturday, December 12

parts.t: A free community party from 3 to 6 p.m., then the parade at 6 p.m. through downtown Aldergrove.

The free drive-through light show usually opens the second weekend of December for about two weeks, with advance registration required and no drop-ins. Watch the Township of Langley's site for 2026 dates.
